\section[regalar]{regalar — to give (as a present)}

\label{lesson:ES-C506-regalar}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Spanish for to rehearse, then the Spanish for success.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: regalar}
\textbf{regalar} — \textquotedblleft{}to give (as a present)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
Le regalo un libro a mi madre.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{I am giving my mother a book.}
\end{quote}

The verb behind \emph{el regalo}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for reading notices, forms and messages.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[envolver]{envolver — to wrap}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: envolver}
